name: Sigma MCP
description: Search, explore, and query Sigma workbooks, data models, and warehouse tables in plain English, build workbooks, and call Sigma agents from MCP clients.

skills.name: Data Search
skills.description: Searches your Sigma organization for workbooks, data models, warehouse tables, and elements by name, type, owner, or connection.

skills.name: Data Source Exploration
skills.description: Describes the columns, data types, definitions, and keys of a Sigma data source so you can confirm it fits your analysis.

skills.name: Natural Language Analysis
skills.description: Queries connections, data models, and workbooks without SQL and reports any workbook filters or controls that shaped the answer.

skills.name: Workbook Building
skills.description: Builds new Sigma workbooks from a description, edits existing ones, and returns a link plus screenshots of pages or elements.

skills.name: Sigma Agent Calls
skills.description: Lists the Sigma agents in a workbook and chats with a chosen agent to forecast, summarize, or update data on your behalf.
